name: R4 Multiple Dwelling, Height District 1
source: LAMC 12.11 C (yards, 400 sf per unit); 12.21.1 A.1 (HD1: FAR 3:1, no height limit for R4)
verified: 2026-09-23 rear yard rule and 400 sf/unit confirmed from 12.11 text; front and side yards follow the R3 pattern (secondary); 'no height limit in HD1' from CP-7150 summary
notes: Front yard: 15 ft. Side yard: 5 ft, +1 ft per story above the 2nd, max 16 ft.
Rear yard: 15 ft, +1 ft per story above the 3rd, need not exceed 20 ft.
Height District 1: no height limit; the envelope is drawn to 150 ft. FAR 3:1 governs.
Density: 400 sf of lot area per dwelling unit.
